messages:
ash: quick Q — where are the saved log queries for EU 'zenith' model route? I need 5xx + kv-cache-miss pattern and a dashboard link I can pin. I'm tuning an alert. thanks

lina: hey @ash — there's a saved view we use. query in the UI: 

```
org:acme AND model:zenith AND route:gen AND region:eu AND status:[500 TO 599] AND (kv_cache_miss:true OR "kv miss")
| stats count() as errors by status
```

link to logs+timeframe: https://console.redwood.internal/logs?query=org%3Aacme+model%3Azenith+route%3Agen+region%3Aeu+status%3A%5B500+TO+599%5D&from=now-1h

Save it from the top-right: 'Save view' → name it `ops/eu-zenith-5xx-kvmiss` → share with `#eng-sre, #oncall` :thumbsup:

lina: dashboard for latency+errors: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/ops-eu-zenith (if you don't have access ping @mike)

mike: for canary route use `route:zenith-canary` and shorten timeframe to `last 15m` when testing deploys. if you want, I can clone the saved view and add a per-route panel.

ash: what's the recommended alert condition? p95? error rate? I'm leaning to an error-rate alert with p95 as a backup

lina: suggestion: create 2 alerts:
1) error-rate: condition = `count(status:[500 TO 599]) / count(*) > 0.005` sustained for 5m (0.5% errors) — triggers page
2) perf-regression: condition = `p95(latency) > 1500` for 5m — P2 notify slack/channel

Example alert query (pseudo):
```
query: org:acme model:zenith region:eu | eval errors=if(status>=500 AND status<600,1,0) | sum(errors)/sum(1) as error_rate
condition: error_rate > 0.005 for 5m
```

mike: also consider KV miss spike alert: track `kv_cache_miss:true` rate and tie to error-rate. sometimes kv misses correlate with 5xx bursts.

srebot: saved view `ops/eu-zenith-5xx-kvmiss` created by lina at 1766667794

ash: perfect, thanks everyone — I'll add the alert links to the runbook and PR a doc snippet. I'll @mike for the dashboard clone.
